subject: a copper observation dome on a suspended rock platform
art_direction: 铜色观景穹顶坐在悬空岩块上，青玻璃与细石纹在晨光中精巧清楚。
visible_description: 铜色观景穹顶坐在悬空岩块上，拱窗暖光与细石纹在晨色中精巧清楚。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a copper observation dome on a suspended rock platform. Keep the dome modest with one broad window and an empty warm interior. A short safe terrace wraps the base, while the rock underside tapers into a compact shape. Render copper seams and soft mineral textures. The upper fifth stays pale and cloud-light, with no dramatic storm or distant floating city. Use cinematic architectural concept painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
